newsitem.title: USA: April paper Brent withers in late-day U.S. trading.
newsitem.headline: April paper Brent withers in late-day U.S. trading.

text.p: North Sea Brent withered in late-day U.S. trading on Tuesday amid moderate buying by a leading broker, traders said.
Four partial paper April Brents changed hands: 50 times at $19.41 a barrel, 50 times at $19.42, 150 times at $19.43 and 200 times at $19.45.
London's IPE settled at $19.47 a barrel for the April contract.
March/April Brent traded at plus 45 cents a barrel, down slightly from afternoon talk, while April/May moved at plus 32 cents, in line with the afternoon range.
